This split-screen image features two distinct 3D-rendered characters against neutral studio backgrounds.

On the left is a chibi-style figure of a young Goku from *Dragon Ball*. He has spiky black hair and a tail, wearing his signature orange gi with a black belt and blue wristbands. He holds a long wooden staff (Power Pole) in one hand and has a determined, slightly smug expression.

On the right stands an anthropomorphic orange-and-white tabby cat, rendered in a soft, Pixar-like style. The cat stands upright on its hind legs with its paws crossed over its chest. It has large, expressive eyes, a small pink nose, and a gentle, curious smile. Its fur is fluffy and detailed, and its tail curls behind it. Both figures are brightly lit and highly stylized, contrasting a classic anime character with a modern CGI animal mascot.
